svg.title: South Korea: construction sheet
svg.text: The cuts in the emblem along the bend are breaks across the charges, 2 long.
The cuts in the emblem along the bend sinister are breaks across the charges, 2 long.
Sizes along a slanting axis are measured along it, and across it square to it.
Not measured on this sheet: the clip on the red disc.
One group of black rects in the emblem
along the bend, turned level: each 4 by
24, 2 apart, broken by a gap 2 long.
